food.excerpt: The Karnataka State Mango Development and Marketing Corporation plans to create a specialized digital platform to boost domestic marketing of Alphonso mangoes, building on its existing Karsiri portal infrastructure.
food.nri_angle: NRI mango lovers who rely on seasonal Alphonso shipments could benefit from a more organized domestic supply chain that may eventually expand to international direct-to-consumer sales.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Coimbatore's EssEmm Corporation Builds ₹100 Crore Business Automating Indian Kitchens
food.excerpt: Founded with ₹25,000 in 1997, the company's Cosmos-brand machines now cook curries, chapatis, and sweets in temples, hospitals, and restaurants across the globe.
food.nri_angle: EssEmm's kitchen automation machines help diaspora restaurant owners maintain consistency in Indian cooking without relying entirely on hard-to-find skilled chefs abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: WestJet Flight Attendants Issue Strike Notice, Threatening Peak Summer Travel
travel.excerpt: Canada's second-largest airline faces a potential walkout starting August 2 after cabin crew issued a 72-hour strike notice over a dispute about unpaid work, with 75,000 passengers at risk.
travel.nri_angle: With over 1.8 million people of Indian origin in Canada, the potential WestJet disruption during peak summer travel could affect diaspora travelers and their connecting itineraries.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Indian Passport Now Offers Visa-Free or Visa-on-Arrival Access to 74 Countries
travel.excerpt: India's Ministry of External Affairs lists 27 visa-free and 47 visa-on-arrival destinations for Indian citizens in 2026, with Malaysia, Thailand, and Kazakhstan among the notable entries.
travel.nri_angle: Indians abroad with U.S., UK, or Schengen visas gain additional visa-free access to countries like Argentina, South Korea, and Mexico, creating new leisure and business travel options.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: IndiGo Signs MoU With Ministry of Tourism to Promote Incredible India
travel.excerpt: India's largest airline partners with the government's flagship tourism initiative as the ministry accelerates corporate tie-ups with airlines, tech companies, and content platforms to modernise the Incredible India brand.
travel.image_caption: IndiGo, India's largest airline, has signed an MoU with the Ministry of Tourism to promote the Incredible India campaign across its network of over 400 aircraft.
travel.nri_angle: IndiGo's expanding international network and codeshare partnerships create new touchpoints for NRIs and PIOs to discover India's tourism offerings on routes they already fly.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: PM Modi Inaugurates Bhogapuram Airport, Andhra Pradesh's First Greenfield Hub
travel.excerpt: The Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport near Visakhapatnam opens with a 6-million passenger capacity and plans to transform North Coastal Andhra's economic landscape.
travel.nri_angle: The new international airport offers direct connectivity options for the Telugu diaspora, particularly those with roots in Visakhapatnam, Vizianagaram, and Srikakulam districts.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Five Structural Barriers That Keep Foreign Tourists Away From India
travel.excerpt: Despite world-class cultural heritage, India captures just 1.4% of global tourist arrivals — held back by visa friction, steep taxes, scam risks, regulatory red tape, and overtourism at flagship destinations.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs who host visiting friends and family in India regularly encounter these barriers firsthand, from visa headaches to tourist scams and overtourism at popular destinations.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: IndiGo to Discontinue All Widebody Operations, End Norse Atlantic Lease
travel.excerpt: India's largest airline will switch Mumbai-Amsterdam to A321XLR and suspend London Heathrow service until its own Airbus A350s arrive, citing geopolitical disruptions.
travel.nri_angle: Indian travelers in the US and UK face disruptions as IndiGo's ambitious long-haul expansion hits turbulence, with London Heathrow service suspended indefinitely and route changes affecting diaspora travel plans.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Danube Hits Record Lows, Stranding Cruise Ships and Threatening Energy Across Central Europe
travel.excerpt: Europe's second-longest river has dropped to unprecedented levels in Hungary, Serbia, and Romania, forcing cruise cancellations, grounding a Viking ship, and pushing Hungary toward a nuclear plant shutdown.
travel.nri_angle: Indian travelers planning European river cruises this summer face widespread itinerary disruptions and cancellations on the Danube and Rhine.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Cordelia Cruises Eyes Mangaluru as Next Port of Call in Fleet Expansion Push
travel.excerpt: Waterways Leisure Tourism, India's only listed domestic cruise operator, is evaluating New Mangalore Port for future cruise services as it prepares to nearly triple fleet capacity by 2028.
travel.image_caption: New Mangalore Port, which Cordelia Cruises is eyeing as its next port of call for Indian coastal routes.
travel.nri_angle: Cordelia's Indian-centric cruise experience and potential Mangaluru embarkation point offer NRI travellers, especially those with ties to coastal Karnataka, a new way to explore India by sea.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: India's Inbound Tourism Problem: Overseas Marketing Budget Slashed to ₹3.5 Crore
travel.excerpt: India's overseas tourism promotion allocation has collapsed from ₹542 crore in 2019 to ₹3.5 crore in FY27, leaving the country's inbound recovery lagging behind competitors while outbound travel booms.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs who promote India as a travel destination to friends and colleagues find the country lacks the institutional marketing that competing destinations deploy.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: SkyDrive and Suzuki Deepen India eVTOL Push with Kineco Manufacturing Pact
travel.excerpt: Japan's SkyDrive has partnered with Indian composite manufacturer Kineco to build parts for its SD-05 air taxi, adding to Suzuki's growing role in bringing eVTOL technology to Indian cities.
travel.nri_angle: The SkyDrive-Suzuki-India partnership could create new aerospace manufacturing jobs in India and bring air taxi services to congested Indian cities.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Dubai's 'Invite' Scheme Offers $800 in Perks to Revive Post-War Tourism
travel.excerpt: UAE residents who nominate overseas visitors arriving before October 31 can unlock hotel stays, attraction tickets, and dining deals worth over AED 3,000 — part of Dubai's aggressive push to rebuild its tourism brand after the Iran conflict.
travel.nri_angle: Over 700,000 Indian nationals in Dubai can use the programme to bring family from India during peak VFR season, with visa-on-arrival eligibility simplifying the process.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani Tells ICE to Leave, Vows Unwavering Support for Immigrant Communities
carousel.excerpt: The Indian-origin mayor of New York City has intensified his confrontation with federal immigration authorities, issuing executive orders restricting ICE access to city facilities and delivering a pointed rebuke of the Trump administration's enforcement tactics.
carousel.nri_angle: Mamdani is the son of Indian-origin parents including filmmaker Mira Nair, representing a new generation of Indian-origin politicians reshaping American politics and directly championing immigrant rights.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Delhi Police Probe Reveals Extent of Violence During CJP's Parliament March
carousel.excerpt: Facial recognition identified nearly 3,000 individuals with criminal records among protesters during the July 20 Sansad Chalo march, as the aftermath sparks a national debate over surveillance, policing, and student rights.
carousel.nri_angle: The NEET paper leak scandal affects diaspora families with children preparing for India's medical entrance exams, while the facial recognition surveillance raises digital privacy concerns resonant with civil liberties debates abroad.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Chennai Love Story Crosses ₹25 Crore Worldwide in Opening Weekend
carousel.excerpt: Kiran Abbavaram's Telugu romantic drama earns ₹17 crore net domestically in three days, surpassing his previous hit SK Kalyana Mandapam to become his third-highest-grossing film.
carousel.nri_angle: The film grossed around $400,000 in North America alone in its opening weekend, reflecting strong demand among Telugu-speaking diaspora audiences.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: India Drawn Against Pakistan in SAFF Championship 2026 Group Stage
carousel.excerpt: The defending champions will face Pakistan on November 5 in Dhaka, adding a high-stakes political dimension to South Asian football's premier tournament.
carousel.image_caption: India has been drawn against Pakistan in the group stage of the SAFF Championship 2026.
carousel.nri_angle: The India-Pakistan football clash in Dhaka will be one of the most politically charged South Asian sporting events of the year, drawing massive attention from diaspora communities worldwide.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Wipro Launches Dedicated Databricks Practice to Scale Enterprise AI
carousel.excerpt: The Indian IT giant sets up a new business practice integrating Databricks capabilities with its AI platforms, targeting industry-specific data modernization and AI deployment.
carousel.nri_angle: Wipro, one of India's largest IT companies, deepens its global AI capabilities through the Databricks partnership, reinforcing the Indian tech industry's central role in enterprise AI transformation.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Loan Investors Dig In as Credit Fears Sweep the Leveraged Finance Market
carousel.excerpt: Fund outflows hit a one-year high, redemption gates are going up at major firms, and lenders are demanding tougher covenants as the $1.2 trillion leveraged loan market enters a defensive phase.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian-origin professionals and investors in the U.S. hold indirect exposure to leveraged loans through 401(k) plans and alternative investment allocations, and the gating of redemptions at major funds underscores a liquidity risk often invisible in portfolio statements.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
